entities.summary: Mason Dale McTavish is a Canadian professional ice hockey player who is a centre and alternate captain for the Anaheim Ducks of the National Hockey League (NHL). McTavish was selected third overall by the Ducks in the 2021 NHL entry draft. He made his NHL debut with the Ducks in 2021. Internationally McTavish played for the Canada national team at the 2022 Winter Olympics.
